mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_order (order_no, customer_id, title, description, deadline, status, created_by) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{deadline}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, customer_id, title, description, deadline, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM material_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_order WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')

SELECT o.id AS `id`, o.order_no AS `orderNo`, o.title AS `title`, o.status AS `status`, o.deadline AS `deadline`, o.created_at AS `createdAt`, c.name AS `customerName`, u.real_name AS `createdByName`, u.username AS `createdByAccount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_task t WHERE t.order_id = o.id) AS `taskTotal`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_task t WHERE t.order_id = o.id AND t.status = 'CONFIRMED') AS `taskConfirmed` FROM material_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.created_by
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.created_by
mapper.update: UPDATE material_order SET status = #{to} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
UPDATE material_order SET deadline = #{deadline} WHERE id = #{id}
